title: Make the historical launcher fixture reject matching legacy digests in every saved record
outcome: The historical fingerprint-only regression would fail if the retired four-digest comparison were restored.
acceptance: The historical fixture sets the same runtime-derived legacy digest in results.expectedFingerprint/before/after and the frozen completion request.expectedFingerprint, removes full source identity proof from both records, and still requires UNKNOWN/input-unverified without rewriting saved artifacts
